# Ryuusei

> Ryuusei (流星) is a fast, detailed app for AniList on iPhone and iPad. It is free to download.

Ryuusei syncs with AniList and lets you track the anime and manga you are watching and reading.
Features include a dashboard for quick progress and score updates, Home Screen widgets showing when anime air next,
system notifications for new episodes, an advanced list entry editor,
detailed media pages with cast, staff, characters, relations, recommendations, tags, and opening/ending songs (for Stargazer members),
seasonal discovery, advanced search, and profile statistics.

Stargazer is an optional subscription that adds extra features and supports development.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone and iPad)
- Price: Free to download; optional Stargazer subscription
- App Store rating: 4.8 / 5
- Data source: AniList (https://anilist.co)
- Affiliation: Not affiliated with AniList
- Developer: Kyle Lanchman
